name: Media Center
description: Control and brand the Media Center app for Android TV.
overview: Default and locked settings for the Media Center app (for everyone or per user), start menu notices, update notices, and your server's own startup chime, sounds, logo, intro title, backdrop and accent colour.

versions.changelog: The settings page has the app's settings straight away (Media Center 1.0's), without waiting for a TV to connect; branding files are replaced whole, never half-written.
First release: settings (defaults, locks, per user), start menu notices, update notices, and branding (chime and sounds, logo, intro title, backdrop, accent colour).
